xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4436: Session Vault: dashboard browse copies (read-only rows for conversations owned by another machine)

plan.title: Session Vault: dashboard browse copies (read-only rows for conversations owned by another machine)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: PAN-2609 saves every conversation to the Session Vault and PAN-4307 makes the primary dashboard pull every record each sync cycle, but a conversation saved on another machine is still invisible in the dashboard; the only way to read it is `pan vault show` in a terminal. PAN-2609 FR-4 asks for browse copies: full transcript through the existing conversation UI, an owner badge, a read-only composer, and no presence in cost totals or agent/runtime views.
narratives.Proposal: After each successful sync cycle, a new engine module (src/lib/vault/browse.ts) decrypts the LOG of every non-owned Claude Code or Codex record into ${OVERDECK_HOME}/vault/browse/ (0600, append-only by manifest), and a new dashboard service (vault-browse-service.ts, subscribed through PAN-4307's onVaultSyncReport) upserts `vault-<vaultId>` rows through a new conversations door (conversation-vault-rows.ts) with origin 'vault', status 'ended', and no conversation_files row, and removes rows and files for tombstoned, owned-here or vanished records. listConversations and two raw readers exclude them; GET /api/conversations appends them through getConversationListWithVaultCopies while the Agents Directory and lanes keep getEnrichedConversationList. resolveSessionFile serves the cache file, reading writes no cost, resume returns 409. The frontend shows `from <machine>` and replaces the composer with a read-only notice carrying `pan vault resume <vaultId>`. getConversationLedgerCosts is extracted first to make room under the conversations.ts file-size cap. Full design: .pan/drafts/PAN-4436.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- "Continue here" in the dashboard, the drift dialog, WIP apply, clone-and-register, project matching by git origin, and "continued on <machine>" states (PAN-4437).
- Browse copies for harnesses other than Claude Code and Codex.
- Rendering the VIEW instead of the LOG.
- Refusing fork or summary-fork of a browse row.
- Removing browse rows when the vault is turned off or its key is missing.
- A "Sync now" button or route; the refresh runs only inside the sync cycle.
- Excluding browse rows from conversation title search.
- Any change to cost ingestion (reconciler and Codex collector roots).
- Any change to the PAN-4307 sync loop, settle poller, eviction or routes other than the main.ts start block.
- CSS module changes, new design tokens, or new per-row actions for browse rows.
- Calling the transcript deletion door from any browse code.
- Editing scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt or CLAUDE.md.
- Changing Delete or Archive for browse rows: delete archives the row and the upsert never touches archived_at, so it stays hidden until its record goes away.

autoDecisions.summary: Browse copies cover claude-code and codex records only (D-1).
autoDecisions.rationale: The dashboard parses only these two and the vault discovers/settles only these two (src/lib/vault/discover.ts).

autoDecisions.summary: The browse cache holds the LOG, not the VIEW (D-2).
autoDecisions.rationale: Browsing shows the full saved transcript; the VIEW is the resume selection and belongs to PAN-4437.

autoDecisions.summary: The cache refresh lives in the vault engine and the row writes in a new dashboard service joined through onVaultSyncReport (D-3, D-4).
autoDecisions.rationale: The vault import graph forbids the engine from importing the conversations door; PAN-4307 FR-13 exports the hook for exactly this.
Every reader that spreads the row carries both fields to the frontend with no per-route code; reads and runtime alias LegacyConversation as Conversation.

autoDecisions.summary: The notice and the resume refusal print the full vaultId instead of an 8-character prefix (D-7).
autoDecisions.rationale: resolveVaultId resolves an exact id without ambiguity, so the copied command always works; the PAN-4307 sibling note suggested id8.

autoDecisions.summary: Forks of a browse row are allowed; removal nulls the four self-referencing foreign keys (D-8).
autoDecisions.rationale: A fork is a new local conversation and leaves the copy untouched; one detach step covers every referencing column instead of a guard per entry point.

autoDecisions.summary: ComposerFooter becomes a wrapper around a renamed ComposerFooterInput (D-9).
autoDecisions.rationale: ComposerFooter calls hooks from its first line, and ConversationPanel.tsx is at its file-size cap.

autoDecisions.summary: Browse rows keep project_key NULL and group by cwd; foreign cwds land in 'No project' (D-11).
autoDecisions.rationale: Project matching by git origin is PAN-4437's scope; the existing grouping rule stays the single source of truth.

autoDecisions.summary: OVERDECK_VAULT_IN_PEER=1 starts the vault and browse services in a peer dashboard (D-12).
autoDecisions.rationale: The isolated Playwright fixture is always a peer, so without an override no browse row could appear for the required UAT; the fixture already spreads process.env so it needs no change.

autoDecisions.summary: One conversation.created event per refresh with changes (D-13).
autoDecisions.rationale: A first sync can create hundreds of rows; the reducer only bumps a revision counter.

autoDecisions.summary: Browse rows persist while the vault is off (D-14).
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4307's cycle calls listeners only when the vault opens; cleanup on vault shutdown is out of scope.
conversations.ts is at its 1222-line cap and agents never raise caps.

autoDecisions.summary: drizzle init SQL gets the two columns alongside the top-ups.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the PAN-4185 and PAN-4223 pattern; tests that apply the init SQL by hand would otherwise fail with no such column.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2 (FR-1, FR-2, FR-5 cache half, NFR-2..NFR-4, D-1, D-2). New engine module exporting BROWSE_DIRNAME, BROWSE_HARNESSES, vaultBrowseDir, isBrowsableVaultId (UUID regex), vaultBrowseFilePath (codex -> rollout-<id>.jsonl, else <id>.jsonl), BrowseCopy, BrowseRefreshResult, refreshBrowseCache({store, keys, rows?}). Manifest browse/manifest.json (0600, temp+rename). Wanted = !ownerIsHere && !tombstone && harness in claude-code/codex && valid id. Per row: skip when manifest updatedAt/harness/bytes match; else load record via refName+readRef+readSessionRecord; append only record.log.slice(entry.chunks) when size matches; else rewrite whole file via temp+rename; per-row try, errors -> failed (file kept). Remove files+entries not kept and not failed using rm under a relative() containment check. NEVER import transcript-deletion-door. Imports only Node built-ins and ./config.js, ./format.js, ./local-index.js, ./identity.js and ./store/types.js (import-graph test); it does NOT import ./materialize.js and defines its own one-line browseFileContent equivalent of nativeFileContent so the conversation-reads -> vault/browse edge adds no import cycle. Tests in tests/unit/lib/vault/browse.test.ts per PRD WI-2 step 7.
